questions.question: Which type of vehicle is most likely to experience the "crack-the-whip" effect?
questions.explanation: Triple trailers are most likely to experience the "crack-the-whip" effect.

questions.question: Trailers with low clearance underneath can be difficult when driving over:
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are difficult to cross with a trailer that has low clearance underneath. Low-slung units and single-axle tractors pulling long trailers have the most trouble crossing raised railroad crossings.

questions.question: When entering or crossing traffic in a combination vehicle, it is especially important that you:

options.text: Make sure there is enough space for your vehicle.
Expect other drivers to make room for you.
Wait for other drivers to wave you into their lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure there is enough space for your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more space than other vehicles. When entering or crossing traffic, make sure there is enough space to do so safely.

questions.question: Set the trailer air supply control to "emergency" to test:
questions.explanation: Test the trailer emergency brakes before your trip. After making sure the trailer moves freely, test the emergency brakes by pulling out the trailer air supply control or setting it to "emergency." Pull forward slightly and make sure the trailer does not move.

questions.question: The ____ trailer is most likely to roll over if a driver turns too quickly.
questions.explanation: Turn smoothly and slowly when pulling trailers. Quick turns are dangerous and increase the risk of the last trailer rolling over.

questions.question: How many air lines does a combination vehicle have?
questions.explanation: A combination vehicle has two air lines: the service line and the emergency line.

questions.question: The service air line is attached to the:
questions.explanation: The service air line carries air and is controlled by the foot brake or trailer hand brake. It is attached to relay valves, which allow the trailer brakes to apply quickly.

questions.question: Push in the trailer air supply control to:
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull out the trailer air supply control to stop the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: What is a tractor protection valve?

options.text: A valve that keeps air in the brake system if there is a bad leak.
A valve that prevents a truck from being stolen.
A valve that prevents the driver from driving too fast.

questions.correctAnswerText: A valve that keeps air in the brake system if there is a bad leak.
questions.explanation: A tractor protection valve keeps air in the tractor or truck brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak. The valve closes automatically if pressure drops too low.

questions.question: Pushing in the trailer air supply control will:
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull out the trailer air supply control to stop the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: A trailer that is too high:
questions.explanation: Before coupling a tractor and trailer, check the trailer height. A trailer that is too low can damage the trailer nose. A trailer that is too high may not couple correctly.

questions.question: When a combination vehicle goes around a corner:

options.text: The turn should be made as tightly as possible.
The front and rear wheels move in different paths.
The rear wheels should run over the curb.
It is acceptable for street signs to be knocked over if they are too close to the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The front and rear wheels move in different paths.
questions.explanation: When a vehicle turns a corner, the rear wheels follow a different path than the front wheels. This is called off-tracking. Trailers make this effect more noticeable.

questions.question: If you must cross traffic while driving a combination vehicle, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will make room for your vehicle.
Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more road space than other vehicles. When entering or crossing traffic, wait for a large enough gap to cross safely.

questions.question: Look into the back of the fifth wheel:

options.text: If your vehicle begins to skid.

questions.explanation: When inspecting a coupling, go under the trailer and look into the back of the fifth wheel. Make sure the fifth wheel jaws are secured around the kingpin shank.

questions.question: The tractor protection valve:

options.text: Ensures that oil adequately lubricates the engine.
Protects the tractor from exceeding a set speed.
Keeps air in the truck braking system if the trailer develops a leak.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeps air in the truck braking system if the trailer develops a leak.
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the tractor brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak. The valve closes automatically if air pressure drops to an unsafe level.

questions.question: The best way to recognize that your trailer has started to skid is by:

options.text: Checking the trailer in your mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Checking the trailer in your mirrors.
questions.explanation: The easiest way to notice a trailer jackknife is to watch it in your mirrors. This also lets you spot skidding as early as possible.

questions.question: During a trip, which shut-off valves should be open?

options.text: All shut-off valves should be open.
The rear shut-off valves should be open.
All shut-off valves should be in the open position, except the rear shut-off valves.
No shut-off valves should be open.

questions.correctAnswerText: All shut-off valves should be in the open position, except the rear shut-off valves.
questions.explanation: When starting a trip, open all shut-off valves except the rear ones. Air must reach the brakes on all trailers but should not escape from the back of the vehicle.

questions.question: In a sudden turn, the ____ trailer is the most likely to turn over.
questions.explanation: When turning, steer gently and smoothly. A quick turn while pulling trailers is dangerous and increases the risk that the last trailer will roll over.

questions.question: When driving a trailer with ABS, you should:

options.text: Not depress the brakes as much as you would when driving a vehicle without ABS.
Use extra braking force to ensure the ABS kicks in.
Brake as you would when driving a vehicle without ABS.
Try to not brakes as often as you would when driving a vehicle without ABS.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake as you would when driving a vehicle without ABS.
questions.explanation: When driving a tractor-trailer with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), brake the same way you would in a vehicle without ABS.

questions.question: When testing ____, you should apply your vehicle's brakes with the hand control while moving the vehicle forward slowly.
questions.explanation: To test the trailer service brakes, make sure the braking system has normal air pressure and the parking brake is released. Move forward slowly and apply the brakes with the hand control. If the trailer service brakes work correctly, you will feel them activate.

questions.question: Keeping cargo low can:
questions.explanation: Low cargo keeps the vehicle's center of gravity low. This helps prevent rollovers, which can happen when you turn too quickly.

questions.question: What does the tractor protection valve do?

options.text: Protects the tractor from being stolen
Protects the tractor from exceeding a set speed
Keeps air in the braking system if the trailer breaks away or leaks
Ensures oil adequately lubricates the engine

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeps air in the braking system if the trailer breaks away or leaks
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the tractor's braking system. It works if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak.

questions.question: Bobtail tractors are ____ to stop than tractors attached to full semitrailers.
questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is one with no trailer attached. It takes longer to stop a bobtail than a tractor with a loaded trailer.

questions.question: A tractor protection valve:

options.text: Keeps air in a brake system if there is a bad leak.
Prevents a truck from being stolen.
Prevents a trailer from being accidentally released.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeps air in a brake system if there is a bad leak.
questions.explanation: A tractor protection valve keeps air in the brake system if the trailer breaks away or develops a bad leak. The valve closes automatically when pressure drops to an unsafe level.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: Regularly to activate the trailer brakes in all driving conditions.
Only to test the trailer brakes.
Only in inclement weather when the trailer may skid.
Only if the trailer is carrying a load.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to test the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: Use the trailer hand valve only to test the trailer brakes. Do not use it while driving because it can cause the trailer to skid.
